Public web + APIs + Maigret only — do NOT touch LinkedIn or X (login/402 walled; another lane owns them). Your final message IS the deliverable: return the structured output below, nothing else.

TARGET: Boris Braylyan — Chief Data & Digital Officer at Parexel (since May 2026; before that SVP Data & Technology at Parexel, Nov 2025). Prior: Pfizer 20 years, VP Global Information Management — Regulatory/Clinical/Safety (Groton CT). School: Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute at Hartford. Based: Raleigh-Durham-Chapel Hill NC. Known: LinkedIn /in/boris-braylyan/.

UNIVERSAL RULES (bind you):
- Per-claim provenance inline: every fact carries its URL or the exact tool/API call. Unsourced → verify first or mark UNVERIFIED.
- DISAMBIGUATION GATE: accept NO account/hit as him without 2+ biographical anchors (Parexel / Pfizer / Raleigh NC / RPI / exact title / a named collaborator). One anchor = a lead, not a match. Same-name collisions are the #1 failure mode. Can't clear the gate → report UNVERIFIED, never as fact.
- Nulls are findings, stated with the count ("checked X, not present"), not "couldn't find any."
- Coverage bounds at the end: what you read, what was walled, what's unverified.

METHOD:
1. Email-first: work emails are guessable + often published (conference bios, papers, WHOIS/Wayback). A Pfizer-decade exec likely has conference/journal bios. Self-owned addresses beat employer-pattern guesses (which stay UNVERIFIED — never assert an aggregator guess).
2. Maigret (installed): /Users/jeffersonstovall/Sites/hm-outreach/tools/venv-maigret/bin/maigret "<handle>" --json simple --no-progressbar --timeout 15 . Generate candidates first: bbraylyan, boris.braylyan, borisbraylyan, braylyan, bbraylyan1, etc. Sweep all. It saturates on bot-protection at ~7% of sites — report coverage % and that it's partial by design.
3. Show-notes / speaker-bio bridge (HIGHEST-YIELD STEP — run it): podcast + conference pages link everything a person owns; podcast RSS carries itunes:email. He attends DPHARM Boston (Fierce Life Sciences, Sept 15-16 2026) — find that page + any panel/speaker bio; hunt other conference appearances (a CDDO speaks). Pfizer-era: papers, patents, journal author bios.
4. Distinctive-phrase search: quote-search an odd verbatim line from his bio.
5. Second, work-only account: always sweep (GitHub, etc.).
6. TRACE (everywhere-but-LinkedIn): X/Twitter, Bluesky, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, Facebook, Substack (also GET https://substack.com/api/v1/user/{SLUG}/public_profile if he has a slug), Medium, GitHub, personal site, podcasts (Listen Notes / Apple / Spotify web), YouTube/conference archives. Report each: found (2 anchors) or not-found or not-distinguishable.
7. Upcoming appearances (rest of 2026): verify DPHARM Boston; find others.

OUTPUT (structured markdown):
- ACCOUNTS: [platform | handle | url | verified/UNVERIFIED | anchors cleared]
- EMAILS: [address | source | verified/UNVERIFIED]
- SOCIAL PRESENCE: x / bluesky / instagram / threads / tiktok / facebook / github / medium / substack / personal-site → found-url | "not found" | "not distinguishable from same-name"
- APPEARANCES + SHOW-NOTES: [what | where | date | topic | url]
- UPCOMING: [event | date | url] or "none found"
- SECOND-ACCOUNT SWEEP result
- MAIGRET coverage % + any hits
- DISAMBIGUATION GUARDS: same-name people to NOT attribute
- THE READ: where he actually lives off LinkedIn, 3-5 lines
- COVERAGE BOUNDS

Boris Braylyan has been elevated to Chief Data & Digital Officer at Parexel, a global clinical research organization (CRO). Previously, he served as Senior Vice President, Data & Technology, where he was responsible for Parexel's enterprise data and technology strategy.

## Professional Experience

Braylyan is a seasoned technology leader with more than two decades of experience shaping the digital future of regulated industries, with a mission to transform how life sciences organizations leverage technology to enhance compliance, accelerate delivery, and improve outcomes.
